split_pipe_entrypoint.sublibraries: Array[Sublibrary] (sublibrary_id + fastq_R1s + fastq_R2s; one entry per sublibrary)
split_pipe_entrypoint.genome_ref_tar_gz: File? (optional; prebuilt split-pipe mkref index. Supply to skip make_reference, omit to build one)
split_pipe_entrypoint.genome_fasta: File (only used when genome_ref_tar_gz is omitted)
split_pipe_entrypoint.genes_gtf: File (only used when genome_ref_tar_gz is omitted)
split_pipe_entrypoint.kit: String (Parse Bio kit versions: WT_mini, WT, WT_mega, WT_mega_384, WT_penta, WT_penta_384)
split_pipe_entrypoint.sample_list_tsv: File (sample name + round-1 wells, one per line)
